en-US.author: Heiko Amft, DL1BZ
en-US.description: SDR transceiver application for OpenHPSDR protocol 1 and 2 amateur radio transceivers.
en-US.longDescription: deskHPSDR by DL1BZ is an mature Open Source desktop application for Hamradio OpenHPSDR SDR transceivers that has been under active development for years. SDR devices based on the OpenHPSDR protocol P1 or P2 are fully supported and both protocol versions are fully supported. It is designed and built as an advanced SDR transceiver front-end application for macOS, Linux and WINDOWS for "every-day-use" and runs now extremely stable and reliable. deskHPSDR is largely based on the WDSP software library by Warren C. Pratt (NR0V), similar to other SDR applications like Thetis for WINDOWS.
en-US.name: deskHPSDR
en-US.releaseNotes:
deskHPSDR 2.8.14
Changes:
- Hermes Lite 2: Add the option to change IP address, back to DHCP, MAC address and add the gateware programmer for .rbf files
- RTTY TX engine: add new option "line_length" for prevent problems with old mechanical RTTY machines (carriage return and line feedback after max. 69 characters), requires rttyPad/rttyTCI version 0.3.1
The x86_64 Intel version is build against Xcode 26.3 and corresonding clang under macOS 15 "Sequoia".
The ARM version is build with the lastest Xcode 27.x version / clang currently under macOS 26 "Tahoe".
The Windows version (64bit native) is build against MSYS2 UCRT64 under Windows 11 Pro.
Note: deskHPSDR get seamless updates. The numeric version numbering (e.g. 2.8.13) is only a requirement for the release option at Github. But the crucial factor is the commit state, which is part of the download filename. Compare it, from time to time I replace the downloads with newer deskHPSDR versions without changing the actual numeric version number. Support always required the use of the latest deskHPSDR version.
Note 2: I never create or publish deskHPSDR binaries or appimages for Linux.

zh-CN.description: 面向 OpenHPSDR 协议 1 和 2 业余无线电收发器的 SDR 应用程序。
zh-CN.longDescription: deskHPSDR 由 DL1BZ 开发，是一款成熟的开源桌面应用程序，专用于业余无线电 OpenHPSDR SDR 收发信机，多年来一直处于积极开发中。它全面支持基于 OpenHPSDR P1 或 P2 协议的 SDR 设备，对这两种协议版本均提供完整支持。该程序专为 macOS、Linux 和 WINDOWS 设计构建，是一款面向“日常使用”的高级 SDR 收发信机前端应用程序，目前运行极其稳定可靠。与 WINDOWS 上的 Thetis 等其他 SDR 应用程序类似，deskHPSDR 很大程度上基于 Warren C. Pratt (NR0V) 的 WDSP 软件库。
